name: Pop-Art Ben-Day
summary: Lichtenstein-style comic panels: Ben-Day dots, speech balloons and a ZAP! that marks the anomaly.
look: Warm white paper, thick ink outlines, tinted teal/amber/coral Ben-Day dot fields, amber caption boxes and stroked uppercase onomatopoeia. Buttons have hard offset comic shadows.

components.name: Comic panel
components.role: thick 10 px ink border around a Ben-Day dot field

components.name: Ben-Day dots
components.role: SVG pattern of offset circles in tinted teal, amber or coral

components.name: Speech balloon
components.role: ellipse + tail; the Acme mark 'speaks' the alert

components.name: Onomatopoeia burst
components.role: spiky star with stroked lettering — PULSE!, ZAP!

components.name: Comic button
components.role: coral pill with hard 10 px ink drop shadow, skewed −6°

motion.name: Panel pop
motion.how: scale 1.15→1 and rotate 2°→0, back.out(2) 0.25 s, one panel per beat

motion.name: Burst bang
motion.how: scale 0→1.1→1 over 0.3 s + ±8 px shake for 4 frames, exactly on the drop and on the anomaly

motion.name: Dot breathe
motion.how: Ben-Day radius 5→6.5→5 px, sine.inOut 0.5 s per beat — the page throbs with the kick

story: Hook: a comic panel full of monitors, balloon: "How many dashboards did I check today?!", caption "Friday, 5:58 PM…". Reveal: a coral/amber burst with the Acme mark and PULSE!. Proof: a chart drops at deploy #2231 with a ZAP!, the Acme mark's balloon shouts checkout conversion −18% since 09:42, and a hand-pressed ROLL BACK! button. CTA: balloon "You ship. Pulse watches." with a Start free comic button.
adapt: Script your product's key moment as three panels — problem, product speaks, human acts — and let your logo be the character with the speech balloon. Your UI can appear on in-panel monitors.

references.note: the printing dot technique and its use in Pop Art
Lichtenstein: Whaam!, bold outlines, flat colour, Ben-Day dots

fit.risk: Juvenile tone can undercut trust for enterprise buyers; dot patterns can moiré after compression.

best_for: dev tools with a playful voice
